verdict.rationale: Fireflies natively offers AskFred, which answers natural-language questions about meeting transcripts. Its official MCP server lets external AI tools such as ChatGPT take natural-language actions on meeting data, including sharing meetings, moving them to folders and creating soundbites. Full natural-language operation therefore depends on a third-party AI client, and the native assistant is limited to Q&A over transcripts. Missing for 10: native in-product natural-language command execution beyond Q&A, broad action coverage across product settings/workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.
